summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte (OMA), a Mexican airport operator, reporting its July 2026 passenger traffic data. The filing discloses a 3.9% year-over-year increase in terminal passenger traffic across its 13 airports, with domestic traffic up 3.3% and international traffic up 7.5%. It also notes three new routes started during the month and provides contact details for investor relations. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is mentioned. The filing is purely operational and informational in nature, with no deal terms or strategic actions disclosed.
